## Context
Preserve the raw source transcript used for the 2026-08-16 rebar-janitor recovery. The tracked, repository-visible anchor for the historical project convention is `.joe-janitor/tools.md`. The rest of `.joe-janitor/` is deliberately local-only through this checkout’s `.git/info/exclude`, so repository-snapshot reviewers will see only `tools.md`; they must not treat absence of the excluded files from a snapshot as evidence that local artifacts do not exist.

Operator-attested local inventory before this task: `.joe-janitor/report-2026-07-07.md`, `.joe-janitor/report-2026-08-06.md`, `.joe-janitor/known-fine.md`, `.joe-janitor/report-2026-08-16-recovered.md`, and `.joe-janitor/tools.md`. `git check-ignore -v .joe-janitor/report-2026-08-16-recovered.md` reports `.git/info/exclude:26:.joe-janitor/`. A home-directory inventory found the comparable dated reports in this project-level directory; sibling worktrees mostly expose the shared tools file and no separate user-level archive with comparable reports was established. These local-only facts are execution evidence, not repository-snapshot premises.

Source: `/Users/joeoakhart/Downloads/ChatGPT-Rebar janitor analysis-20260816-0915.md`
Destination: `.joe-janitor/raw-chat-2026-08-16.md`

The copy must preserve the source bytes exactly. If the destination is absent, create it; if it already exists and is byte-identical, leave it unchanged; if it exists with different bytes, do not overwrite it—stop and record both checksums for operator resolution. Do not modify the already-attested recovery report; instead record source/destination SHA-256, size, and line count on this ticket. This is a local artifact-preservation task and changes no tracked repository or production-code file.

## Plan
- Confirm the source exists and apply the explicit absent/identical/divergent destination policy above.
- Copy the raw transcript byte-for-byte into the project-level `.joe-janitor/` archive only when the destination is absent.
- Verify source and destination SHA-256, byte count, line count, and exact comparison.
- Confirm via the checkout’s own Git commands that the destination remains excluded and the tracked worktree remains clean.
- Record the final artifact path and verification evidence on this ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] [operator-attested] `.joe-janitor/raw-chat-2026-08-16.md` exists and is byte-identical to the Downloads source.
  provenance: environment=local-checkout-b0aac2314; principal=joeoakhart@navapbc.com; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Compare source and destination and record both SHA-256 values, sizes, and line counts on this ticket.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The preserved transcript and `.joe-janitor/report-2026-08-16-recovered.md` are colocated in the checkout-local archive.
  provenance: environment=local-checkout-b0aac2314; principal=joeoakhart@navapbc.com; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — List the local archive directory and record both exact artifact paths on this ticket; repository-snapshot tools cannot observe intentionally excluded files.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Git reports the destination excluded by the checkout-local exclude configuration.
  provenance: environment=local-checkout-b0aac2314; principal=joeoakhart@navapbc.com; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Record `git check-ignore -v` output for the destination on this ticket.
- [ ] No tracked repository file is modified.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A ticket comment records the archive path and integrity evidence.
  provenance: environment=tickets-store-origin; principal=joeoakhart@navapbc.com; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Read back the ticket comment containing destination, checksum, size, line count, comparison result, and git status.
